title: A weekend hike
scene: Two friends plan a trip to the mountains

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 这个周末你有什么打算？
lines.py: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
lines.en: What are your plans for this weekend?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我想去爬山，听说山上的花都开了。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù pá shān, tīngshuō shān shàng de huā dōu kāi le.
lines.en: I want to go hiking. I hear the flowers on the mountain are all in bloom.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 是吗？我也想去。你打算什么时候出发？
lines.py: Shì ma? Wǒ yě xiǎng qù. Nǐ dǎsuàn shénme shíhou chūfā?
lines.en: Really? I'd like to go too. When are you planning to leave?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 星期六早上七点，我们在地铁站见面吧。
lines.py: Xīngqīliù zǎoshang qī diǎn, wǒmen zài dìtiězhàn jiànmiàn ba.
lines.en: Saturday at seven in the morning. Let's meet at the subway station.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 七点太早了，能不能八点？
lines.py: Qī diǎn tài zǎo le, néng bu néng bā diǎn?
lines.en: Seven is too early. Could we make it eight?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 不行，山很远，坐车要两个小时，太晚了人会很多。
lines.py: Bùxíng, shān hěn yuǎn, zuò chē yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí, tài wǎn le rén huì hěn duō.
lines.en: No. The mountain is far, two hours by bus, and if we're late there'll be lots of people.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好吧。要带什么东西？
lines.py: Hǎo ba. Yào dài shénme dōngxi?
lines.en: All right. What should I bring?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 带一些水和水果，山上的东西很贵。
lines.py: Dài yìxiē shuǐ hé shuǐguǒ, shān shàng de dōngxi hěn guì.
lines.en: Bring some water and fruit. Things on the mountain are expensive.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 听说星期六可能会下雨，需要带伞吗？
lines.py: Tīngshuō xīngqīliù kěnéng huì xià yǔ, xūyào dài sǎn ma?
lines.en: I heard it might rain on Saturday. Should we bring umbrellas?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 带吧。下雨的话，我们就在山下的饭馆吃饭。
lines.py: Dài ba. Xià yǔ dehuà, wǒmen jiù zài shān xià de fànguǎn chī fàn.
lines.en: Yes. If it rains, we'll just eat at a restaurant at the foot of the mountain.

questions.prompt: 他们这个周末打算去做什么？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen zhège zhōumò dǎsuàn qù zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What are they planning to do this weekend?
questions.explanation: She says 我想去爬山 in line 2 and he wants to join.

questions.prompt: 他们几点在哪儿见面？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen jǐ diǎn zài nǎr jiànmiàn?
questions.promptEn: When and where will they meet?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 早上七点 at the 地铁站. He asks for eight, but she says no.

questions.prompt: 女的为什么不想八点出发？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de wèi shénme bù xiǎng bā diǎn chūfā?
questions.promptEn: Why doesn't the woman want to leave at eight?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says the mountain is two hours away and 太晚了人会很多.

questions.prompt: 女的为什么让男的带水果？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de wèi shénme ràng nán de dài shuǐguǒ?
questions.promptEn: Why does she tell him to bring fruit?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says 山上的东西很贵.

questions.prompt: 如果下雨，他们打算怎么办？
questions.promptPy: Rúguǒ xià yǔ, tāmen dǎsuàn zěnme bàn?
questions.promptEn: What will they do if it rains?
questions.explanation: Line 10 says 下雨的话，我们就在山下的饭馆吃饭.

title: Moving to a new place
scene: Two coworkers talk about a new apartment

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 听说你搬家了？新房子怎么样？
lines.py: Tīngshuō nǐ bānjiā le? Xīn fángzi zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: I heard you moved. How's the new place?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 挺好的，比以前的大，有两个房间。
lines.py: Tǐng hǎo de, bǐ yǐqián de dà, yǒu liǎng gè fángjiān.
lines.en: Pretty good. It's bigger than my old one and has two rooms.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 在哪儿？离公司远吗？
lines.py: Zài nǎr? Lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
lines.en: Where is it? Is it far from the office?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 在城市东边的一个小区，离公司很近，骑自行车10分钟就到了。
lines.py: Zài chéngshì dōngbian de yí gè xiǎoqū, lí gōngsī hěn jìn, qí zìxíngchē shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lines.en: It's in a housing estate on the east side of the city, close to the office. Ten minutes by bike.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那太方便了！以前你每天坐地铁要一个小时吧？
lines.py: Nà tài fāngbiàn le! Yǐqián nǐ měitiān zuò dìtiě yào yí gè xiǎoshí ba?
lines.en: That's so convenient! Before, you spent an hour on the subway every day, right?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 对，所以我决定搬家。而且新家附近有一个大公园，周末可以去跑步。
lines.py: Duì, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng bānjiā. Érqiě xīn jiā fùjìn yǒu yí gè dà gōngyuán, zhōumò kěyǐ qù pǎobù.
lines.en: Right, that's why I decided to move. And there's a big park near the new place, so I can go running on weekends.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 房子贵不贵？
lines.py: Fángzi guì bu guì?
lines.en: Is it expensive?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 比以前的贵一点儿，一个月四千块。
lines.py: Bǐ yǐqián de guì yìdiǎnr, yí gè yuè sìqiān kuài.
lines.en: A bit more than the old one, four thousand kuai a month.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 什么时候请我们去做客？
lines.py: Shénme shíhou qǐng wǒmen qù zuòkè?
lines.en: When are you inviting us over?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 下个星期六吧，我做饭给大家吃。
lines.py: Xià ge xīngqīliù ba, wǒ zuò fàn gěi dàjiā chī.
lines.en: How about next Saturday? I'll cook for everyone.

questions.prompt: 新房子有几个房间？
questions.promptPy: Xīn fángzi yǒu jǐ gè fángjiān?
questions.promptEn: How many rooms does the new place have?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says 有两个房间.

questions.prompt: 男的现在怎么去公司？
questions.promptPy: Nán de xiànzài zěnme qù gōngsī?
questions.promptEn: How does the man get to work now?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 骑自行车10分钟就到了. The subway was how he went before.

questions.prompt: 男的为什么搬家？
questions.promptPy: Nán de wèi shénme bānjiā?
questions.promptEn: Why did the man move?
options: 以前去公司要很长时间
questions.explanation: Line 5 says he spent an hour on the subway every day, and in line 6 he answers 对，所以我决定搬家. The new place costs more, not less.

questions.prompt: 新房子一个月多少钱？
questions.promptPy: Xīn fángzi yí gè yuè duōshao qián?
questions.promptEn: How much is the new place per month?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says 一个月四千块.

questions.prompt: 男的打算什么时候请朋友去做客？
questions.promptPy: Nán de dǎsuàn shénme shíhou qǐng péngyou qù zuòkè?
questions.promptEn: When does the man plan to have friends over?
questions.explanation: Line 10 says 下个星期六吧.

title: A summer trip south
scene: A woman remembers a trip with her older sister

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我和姐姐去南方旅游了一个星期。
lines.py: Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒ hé jiějie qù nánfāng lǚyóu le yí gè xīngqī.
lines.en: Last summer my older sister and I traveled in the south for a week.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我们是坐高铁去的，路上用了五个小时。
lines.py: Wǒmen shì zuò gāotiě qù de, lùshang yòngle wǔ gè xiǎoshí.
lines.en: We went by high-speed train. The trip took five hours.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那里的夏天特别热，所以我们白天常常在宾馆里休息，晚上才出去玩。
lines.py: Nàlǐ de xiàtiān tèbié rè, suǒyǐ wǒmen báitiān chángcháng zài bīnguǎn lǐ xiūxi, wǎnshang cái chūqù wán.
lines.en: Summer there is really hot, so we often rested in the hotel during the day and only went out at night.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 晚上的街上人很多，有很多好吃的东西。
lines.py: Wǎnshang de jiē shang rén hěn duō, yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi.
lines.en: The streets were crowded at night, with lots of good food.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我最喜欢那里的鱼，又新鲜又便宜。
lines.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan nàlǐ de yú, yòu xīnxiān yòu piányi.
lines.en: I liked the fish there best. It was fresh and cheap.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 第三天，我们去了海边，姐姐在那里照了很多照片。
lines.py: Dì-sān tiān, wǒmen qùle hǎibiān, jiějie zài nàlǐ zhàole hěn duō zhàopiàn.
lines.en: On the third day we went to the beach, and my sister took lots of photos there.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 可是那天我在海里游泳的时间太长，晚上就感冒了。
lines.py: Kěshì nà tiān wǒ zài hǎi lǐ yóuyǒng de shíjiān tài cháng, wǎnshang jiù gǎnmào le.
lines.en: But that day I swam in the sea for too long and caught a cold that night.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我在宾馆里休息了两天，身体才好。
lines.py: Wǒ zài bīnguǎn lǐ xiūxile liǎng tiān, shēntǐ cái hǎo.
lines.en: I had to rest in the hotel for two days before I got better.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 虽然生病了，但是这次旅游还是很有意思。明年我们还想去。
lines.py: Suīrán shēngbìng le, dànshì zhè cì lǚyóu háishi hěn yǒu yìsi. Míngnián wǒmen hái xiǎng qù.
lines.en: Even though I got sick, the trip was still a lot of fun. We want to go again next year.

questions.prompt: 她们是怎么去南方的？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen shì zěnme qù nánfāng de?
questions.promptEn: How did they travel to the south?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says 我们是坐高铁去的.

questions.prompt: 她们为什么白天在宾馆里休息？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen wèi shénme báitiān zài bīnguǎn lǐ xiūxi?
questions.promptEn: Why did they rest in the hotel during the day?
questions.explanation: Line 3 says 夏天特别热，所以 they rested during the day. The one who got sick was the speaker, not her sister.

questions.prompt: 她觉得那里的鱼怎么样？
questions.promptPy: Tā juéde nàlǐ de yú zěnmeyàng?
questions.promptEn: What did she think of the fish there?
questions.explanation: Line 5 says 又新鲜又便宜.

questions.prompt: 第三天她们去了哪儿？
questions.promptPy: Dì-sān tiān tāmen qùle nǎr?
questions.promptEn: Where did they go on the third day?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says 第三天，我们去了海边.

questions.prompt: 她为什么感冒了？
questions.promptPy: Tā wèi shénme gǎnmào le?
questions.promptEn: Why did she catch a cold?
options: 在海里游泳的时间太长
questions.explanation: Line 7 says 我在海里游泳的时间太长，晚上就感冒了.

title: Calling in sick
scene: A student phones his teacher in the morning

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 喂，老师，您好。我是小张。
lines.py: Wéi, lǎoshī, nín hǎo. Wǒ shì Xiǎo Zhāng.
lines.en: Hello, teacher. This is Xiao Zhang.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 小张，你好。有什么事吗？
lines.py: Xiǎo Zhāng, nǐ hǎo. Yǒu shénme shì ma?
lines.en: Hi, Xiao Zhang. What's up?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我从昨天晚上开始发烧，今天想请假，不能去上课了。
lines.py: Wǒ cóng zuótiān wǎnshang kāishǐ fāshāo, jīntiān xiǎng qǐngjià, bù néng qù shàngkè le.
lines.en: I've had a fever since last night. I'd like to take today off. I can't come to class.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 没关系，身体最重要。你去医院检查了吗？
lines.py: Méi guānxi, shēntǐ zuì zhòngyào. Nǐ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchále ma?
lines.en: That's fine, your health comes first. Have you been to the hospital for a checkup?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 去了，医生说是感冒，让我在家休息两天。
lines.py: Qù le, yīshēng shuō shì gǎnmào, ràng wǒ zài jiā xiūxi liǎng tiān.
lines.en: Yes. The doctor said it's a cold and told me to rest at home for two days.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好的。今天的作业我会发到你的邮箱。
lines.py: Hǎo de. Jīntiān de zuòyè wǒ huì fā dào nǐ de yóuxiāng.
lines.en: OK. I'll send today's homework to your email.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 谢谢老师。星期五的数学考试我能参加吗？
lines.py: Xièxie lǎoshī. Xīngqīwǔ de shùxué kǎoshì wǒ néng cānjiā ma?
lines.en: Thank you. Can I still take Friday's math test?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 如果你那天好了，就来参加；如果还不舒服，就下个星期再考。
lines.py: Rúguǒ nǐ nà tiān hǎo le, jiù lái cānjiā; rúguǒ hái bù shūfu, jiù xià ge xīngqī zài kǎo.
lines.en: If you're better by then, come and take it. If you still don't feel well, you can take it next week.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好的，我一定认真复习。
lines.py: Hǎo de, wǒ yídìng rènzhēn fùxí.
lines.en: OK, I'll be sure to review carefully.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 别着急，先把身体照顾好。
lines.py: Bié zháojí, xiān bǎ shēntǐ zhàogù hǎo.
lines.en: Don't worry. Take care of your health first.

questions.prompt: 小张为什么给老师打电话？
questions.promptPy: Xiǎo Zhāng wèi shénme gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà?
questions.promptEn: Why does Xiao Zhang call his teacher?
questions.explanation: Line 3 says he has a fever and 今天想请假.

questions.prompt: 医生让他做什么？
questions.promptPy: Yīshēng ràng tā zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What did the doctor tell him to do?
questions.explanation: Line 5 says the doctor 让我在家休息两天.

questions.prompt: 老师会怎么把作业给他？
questions.promptPy: Lǎoshī huì zěnme bǎ zuòyè gěi tā?
questions.promptEn: How will the teacher get the homework to him?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says 作业我会发到你的邮箱.

questions.prompt: 星期五有什么考试？
questions.promptPy: Xīngqīwǔ yǒu shénme kǎoshì?
questions.promptEn: What test is on Friday?
questions.explanation: Line 7 mentions 星期五的数学考试.

questions.prompt: 如果星期五他还不舒服，怎么办？
questions.promptPy: Rúguǒ xīngqīwǔ tā hái bù shūfu, zěnme bàn?
questions.promptEn: What happens if he still feels unwell on Friday?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says 如果还不舒服，就下个星期再考.

title: The meeting is moved
scene: An employee checks tomorrow's meeting with her manager

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 经理，明天上午的会议还是九点开始吗？
lines.py: Jīnglǐ, míngtiān shàngwǔ de huìyì háishi jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ ma?
lines.en: Manager, does tomorrow morning's meeting still start at nine?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 不是，我们换到下午两点了。
lines.py: Bú shì, wǒmen huàn dào xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn le.
lines.en: No, we've moved it to two in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 为什么换时间了？
lines.py: Wèi shénme huàn shíjiān le?
lines.en: Why was the time changed?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 因为有几位客人的飞机晚点了，明天中午才到。
lines.py: Yīnwèi yǒu jǐ wèi kèrén de fēijī wǎndiǎn le, míngtiān zhōngwǔ cái dào.
lines.en: Some of the guests' flights are delayed. They won't arrive until tomorrow at noon.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 会议还在三层的会议室吗？
lines.py: Huìyì hái zài sān céng de huìyìshì ma?
lines.en: Is the meeting still in the meeting room on the third floor?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 不，那个会议室太小了。我们用八层那个大的。
lines.py: Bù, nàge huìyìshì tài xiǎo le. Wǒmen yòng bā céng nàge dà de.
lines.en: No, that room is too small. We'll use the big one on the eighth floor.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好的。我需要准备什么？
lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ xūyào zhǔnbèi shénme?
lines.en: OK. What do I need to prepare?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你帮我准备十位客人的饮料和水果。
lines.py: Nǐ bāng wǒ zhǔnbèi shí wèi kèrén de yǐnliào hé shuǐguǒ.
lines.en: Please get drinks and fruit ready for ten guests.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 客人晚上住在哪儿？需要我找一个宾馆吗？
lines.py: Kèrén wǎnshang zhù zài nǎr? Xūyào wǒ zhǎo yí gè bīnguǎn ma?
lines.en: Where are the guests staying tonight? Should I find a hotel?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 不用了，他们开完会就坐高铁回去。
lines.py: Búyòng le, tāmen kāiwán huì jiù zuò gāotiě huíqù.
lines.en: No need. They'll take the high-speed train back right after the meeting.

questions.prompt: 会议现在几点开始？
questions.promptPy: Huìyì xiànzài jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?
questions.promptEn: What time does the meeting start now?
questions.explanation: Line 2 says it was moved 到下午两点. Nine was the old time.

questions.prompt: 为什么换时间？
questions.promptPy: Wèi shénme huàn shíjiān?
questions.promptEn: Why was the time changed?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says 因为有几位客人的飞机晚点了.

questions.prompt: 会议在几层开？
questions.promptPy: Huìyì zài jǐ céng kāi?
questions.promptEn: Which floor is the meeting on?
questions.explanation: Line 6 says the third-floor room is too small, so they will use the one on 八层.

questions.prompt: 女的要准备什么？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de yào zhǔnbèi shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the woman need to prepare?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says 准备十位客人的饮料和水果.

questions.prompt: 客人开完会以后做什么？
questions.promptPy: Kèrén kāiwán huì yǐhòu zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What will the guests do after the meeting?
questions.explanation: Line 10 says no hotel is needed because 他们开完会就坐高铁回去.

title: Getting back in shape
scene: An office worker talks about starting to run

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 以前我工作很忙，每天在办公室坐十个小时，也不锻炼身体。
lines.py: Yǐqián wǒ gōngzuò hěn máng, měitiān zài bàngōngshì zuò shí gè xiǎoshí, yě bú duànliàn shēntǐ.
lines.en: I used to be very busy at work. I sat in the office ten hours a day and never exercised.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 去年我胖了十公斤，还经常感冒。
lines.py: Qùnián wǒ pàngle shí gōngjīn, hái jīngcháng gǎnmào.
lines.en: Last year I put on ten kilos and caught colds all the time.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 医生告诉我，如果不运动，身体会越来越差。
lines.py: Yīshēng gàosu wǒ, rúguǒ bú yùndòng, shēntǐ huì yuè lái yuè chà.
lines.en: My doctor told me that if I didn't exercise, my health would keep getting worse.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 所以我决定每天早上去小区旁边的公园跑步。
lines.py: Suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng měitiān zǎoshang qù xiǎoqū pángbiān de gōngyuán pǎobù.
lines.en: So I decided to run every morning in the park next to my housing estate.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 开始的时候，我跑10分钟就累了。
lines.py: Kāishǐ de shíhou, wǒ pǎo shí fēnzhōng jiù lèi le.
lines.en: At first I got tired after ten minutes.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 后来我的邻居也和我一起跑，我们一边跑一边聊天儿，时间过得很快。
lines.py: Hòulái wǒ de línjū yě hé wǒ yìqǐ pǎo, wǒmen yìbiān pǎo yìbiān liáotiānr, shíjiān guò de hěn kuài.
lines.en: Later my neighbor started running with me. We chat while we run, and the time goes by fast.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 现在我每天能跑40分钟，已经瘦了五公斤。
lines.py: Xiànzài wǒ měitiān néng pǎo sìshí fēnzhōng, yǐjīng shòule wǔ gōngjīn.
lines.en: Now I can run forty minutes a day, and I've already lost five kilos.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 下个月，我们打算参加城市的跑步比赛。
lines.py: Xià ge yuè, wǒmen dǎsuàn cānjiā chéngshì de pǎobù bǐsài.
lines.en: Next month we plan to enter the city running race.

questions.prompt: 他以前为什么不锻炼身体？
questions.promptPy: Tā yǐqián wèi shénme bú duànliàn shēntǐ?
questions.promptEn: Why didn't he exercise before?
questions.explanation: Line 1 says 以前我工作很忙 and he sat in the office all day.

questions.prompt: 医生告诉他什么？
questions.promptPy: Yīshēng gàosu tā shénme?
questions.promptEn: What did the doctor tell him?
options: 不运动身体会越来越差
questions.explanation: Line 3 says 如果不运动，身体会越来越差.

questions.prompt: 他每天早上在哪儿跑步？
questions.promptPy: Tā měitiān zǎoshang zài nǎr pǎobù?
questions.promptEn: Where does he run every morning?
questions.explanation: Line 4 says he runs in 小区旁边的公园.

questions.prompt: 他现在每天能跑多长时间？
questions.promptPy: Tā xiànzài měitiān néng pǎo duō cháng shíjiān?
questions.promptEn: How long can he run each day now?
questions.explanation: Line 7 says 现在我每天能跑40分钟. Ten minutes was when he started.

questions.prompt: 他们下个月打算做什么？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen xià ge yuè dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
questions.promptEn: What do they plan to do next month?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says 我们打算参加城市的跑步比赛.
